title: Saral Vastu Gyan
author: Anshuman Krit
publication_date: Not widely available (likely self-published or regional, with limited information)
target_audience: Individuals seeking spiritual harmony within living spaces
Architecture and interior design students with an interest in traditional Indian knowledge
core_themes: Harmony between environment, architecture, and well-being
Removing Vastu-related obstacles in daily life
Ancient Indian wisdom applied to modern homes
primary_purpose: To explain the foundational principles of Vastu Shastra and offer straightforward, practical guidance for readers to enhance their living or working environments, thereby promoting health, happiness, and prosperity through spatial harmony.

structure_format.organization: Divided into thematic chapters (e.g., kitchen placement, entryways, bedrooms, remedies for defects)
features: Remedies and tips for common Vastu doshas (defects)
Case studies and examples from real homes

key_concepts_lessons: Proper orientation and layout of rooms lead to better flow of positive energy.
Each direction (north, south, east, west) has specific importance in Vastu.
Common Vastu doshas can be remedied with simple changes (e.g., shifting furniture, adding plants, using colors).
The placement of objects and entryways affects mental peace and prosperity.
Even small modifications can yield noticeable improvements in home and work life.
notable_features: Focus on practical, easy-to-implement Vastu tips
Addresses both theoretical and remedial aspects
Written for laypersons with limited prior knowledge
cultural_historical_context: Vastu Shastra is an ancient Indian science of architecture and spatial harmony, originating from centuries-old texts. Interest in Vastu surged in contemporary India as people sought traditional ways to create peaceful and prosperous living spaces. This book adapts old wisdom for modern needs.
reception_impact: Appreciated by lay readers for its straightforward approach and actionable guidance
Popular in regional markets and among Vastu enthusiasts
Not widely reviewed in mainstream press but valued in Vastu and spiritual circles
comparable_titles: Vastu: Breathing Life into Space by Dr. Robert E. Svoboda
Vastu Shastra: For A Healthy, Prosperous And Happy life by B. Niranjan Babu
